question: Are empty centers at birth of spontaneous exact 3x3 eight-member ring pockets distinguishable from local lattice occupancy at fixed checkpoints, under unchanged M6 dynamics?

hypotheses.H1: Some natural exact 3x3 ring pockets contain a mobile unbonded native central particle at birth and geometrically confine it >=30 observed ticks.
hypotheses.H2: The central site of native pocket births is more frequently empty than centers of physically complete eight-site perimeter shells sampled at fixed times; any contrast is descriptive and cannot establish causality.
hypotheses.H3: Perimeter shells with 6 or 7 of their eight possible cycle edges bonded allow comparison of occupancy close to closure; occupancy at such candidate sites is sampled regardless of eventual ring completion.

sample.geometry: 24x24 periodic M6.4 natural world; zero bonds initially; original M6 laws/parameters; 200 and 264 particles
sample.control_centers: all 576 toroidal centers at every prespecified fixed checkpoint, counted only when all eight perimeter sites are occupied by native particles
sample.native_pocket: 8 native materials/8 native bonds, all ring member degree 2, exactly the eight 3x3 perimeter positions, excludes ring connected to any center occupant

measurements.primary: world count with one or more native pockets containing at birth a native central degree-0 particle with move_probability>0 and 30 consecutive ticks before any original edge breaks
measurements.pocket_births: same material+edge key with a new episode after original bond-break, geometry change or absence; record both episodes and distinct material ID sets; report earliest pocket birth per world separately to avoid treating reclosure as independence
measurements.controls: for each fixed checkpoint count full shells, free-monomer occupied centers, bonded occupied centers, empty centers; split by perimeter native edge count (0-5, 6, 7, 8), and by density; count zero-control worlds
measurements.prebirth: for every new pocket episode, record center occupancy at immediately previous tick and at birth, and previous perimeter edge count if all eight perimeter sites were occupied; absent shell reported explicitly
measurements.independent_units: independent seed x density world; repeated episodes within a world and repeated fixed checkpoints are dependent descriptive observations
measurements.quality: no RNG consumption in observer; two independent bare replays equal full world hash, RNG fingerprint and draws, energy, dissipated and bond counters; raw per-world outcomes including zero cases

decision.natural_trapping: If >=2 distinct newly sampled worlds have >=30 tick native trapped free mobile residents, label replicated_native_geometric_trapping_only; else one_case / no_confirmed_trapping
decision.occupancy_contrast: Report free-monomer occupancy proportions separately for all shells, near-closure 7-edge shells and pocket births; do not compute significance from episodes or infer biological membranes, intentional avoidance or causality.
decision.missing_control: If near-closure 7-edge or native pockets are too rare, explicitly state that data are insufficient rather than interpreting zero cases.
